{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for QA orders: revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Also check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")

# Filter for completed orders only, as the question asks for "completed order"
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Now compute mean revenue for completed orders
mean_revenue_completed = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].mean()
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue_completed}")"}
